description.en: Meishan Reservoir occupies the upper Shi River in Jinzhai County and serves flood control, irrigation and electricity generation. It is a major part of the Huai River water-management system and a principal source for the Pishihang irrigation network.
description.zh-CN: 梅山水库位于中国安徽省六安市金寨县史河上游，是以防洪、灌溉、发电为主要功能的大型水库，也是治理淮河的重要水利工程之一。 梅山水库是淠史杭灌区的主要水源之一，灌溉下游的安徽、河南二省五县区383万亩农田。
description.zh-TW: 梅山水庫位於中國安徽省六安市金寨縣史河上游，是以防洪、灌溉、發電爲主要功能的大型水庫，也是治理淮河的重要水利工程之一。 梅山水庫是淠史杭灌區的主要水源之一，灌溉下游的安徽、河南二省五縣區383萬畝農田。

description.en: Lu'an is a prefecture-level city in western Anhui province, People's Republic of China, bordering Henan to the northwest and Hubei to the southwest. As of the 2020 census, it had a total population of 4,393,699 inhabitants whom 1,752,537 lived in the built-up area made of Yu'an and Jin'an urban districts.
